scope: Individual line badges only; operator logos, station data and route palette excluded.

sourceBasis.description: All six individual KRT line icons from Wikimedia Commons; retain each individual sign.

license: Wikimedia Commons PD-textlogo; see the linked individual file pages.
reproduction: SVG outlines retained where available. Standard Commons PNG previews are embedded losslessly for files whose original SVG downloads were rate-limited. Local generation is offline and verifies every cached source SHA256.
limitations: Some source badges are standard 330-pixel Commons previews, adequate for their much smaller UI display.
